C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies.           },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.388799250125885
    },

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { headers } from \"next/headers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\nexport default async function Page({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n  // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n  // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n  if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n    // Use next parameter if available, otherwise default\n    const params = await searchParams;\n    const next = params.next;\n\n    // Get origin from headers for validation\n    const headersList = await headers();\n    const host = headersList.get(\"host\");\n    const protocol = headersList.get(\"x-forwarded-proto\") || \"http\";\n    const origin = host ? &#96;${protocol}://${host}&#96; : \"\";\n\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      const redirectTo = next ??         "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n  // Include full path with query parameters and hash for next parameter\n  const fullPath = pathname + request.nextUrl.search + request.nextUrl.hash;\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or         "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"absolute top-6 right-6 md:top-10 md:right-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm next={next} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile, redirectWithCookies } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Safely executes an async check function, catching any errors\n * and treating them as a failed check to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n * @param checkFn - The async function to execute\n * @param checkName - Name of the check for logging purposes\n * @returns Object with ok boolean and optional error\n */\nasync function safeCheck(\n  checkFn: () =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;,\n  checkName: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ ok: boolean; error?: Error }&gt; {\n  try {\n    const result = await checkFn();\n    return { ok: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\n    console.error(&#96;Error in ${checkName}:&#96;, err);\n    return { ok: false, error: err };\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "  v_has_linked_profile boolean;\nbegin\n  if tg_op != 'UPDATE' then\n    return NEW;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Check if user has a linked profile before allowing email changes\n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n\n  -- If user exists, check if they have a linked profile\n  if v_user_id is not null then\n    select exists (\n      select 1\n      from public.profiles\n      where user_id = v_user_id\n    ) into v_has_linked_profile;\n\n    -- If user has a linked profile, prevent email changes\n    if v_has_linked_profile then\n      if OLD.email is distinct from NEW.email then\n        raise exception 'Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.';\n      end if;\n      \n      if OLD.email_change is distinct from NEW.email_change then\n        raise exception 'Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.';\n      end if;\n    end if;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Continue with existing domain validation for email_change\n  if OLD.email_change is distinct from NEW.email_change then\n    v_email_change := NEW.email_change;\n    \n    if v_email_change is not null and v_email_change != '' then\n      v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email_change, '@', 2));\n      \n      if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n        raise exception 'Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz. Provided domain: %', v_domain;\n      end if;\n    end if;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Continue with existing domain validation for email\n  if OLD.email is distinct from NEW.email then\n    v_email := NEW.email;\n    \n    if v_email is not null and v_email != '' then\n      v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n      \n      if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n        raise exception 'Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz. Provided domain: %', v_domain;\n      end if;\n    end if;\n  end if;\n\n  return NEW;\nend;\n$$;",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

            "text": "### Verification Logic",

          {
            "lineNumber": 157

            "text": "- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email",

## Summary

Updated `/app/auth/verify-email/page.tsx` to automatically redirect users with linked profiles, matching the pattern used in the pending-approval page.

### Changes Made:

1. Added imports:
   - `hasLinkedProfile` from `@/lib/auth-helpers`
   - `DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE` from `@/lib/constants/auth`

2. Added redirect logic:
   - After authentication check, checks if the user has a linked profile
   - If they do, redirects to the `next` parameter (if provided) or `DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE` (`/protected`)
   - This prevents users with linked profiles from accessing the verify-email page

### Behavior:

- Users without a linked profile: see the verify-email form
- Users with a linked profile: redirected to `/protected` (or the `next` parameter if provided)
- Unauthenticated users: redirected to `/auth/login`

This ensures users with linked profiles are automatically redirected away from the verify-email page, consistent with the pending-approval page behavior.
